Name: Otter's Morris Sprites
Author: Otterlyadorable
Description:
[center]Disclaimer:
Please don't re-upload or re-distribute or trace over my Mod/ Sprites and especially not behind a paywall! It would be very disrespectful of my efforts and work plus it's not a nice thing to do. This was done just so I could practice doing sprites and is meant to be free to enjoy and not for profit. They may not be amazing but I did work hard on them.
This mod should only be available for download here on Nexus and on the stardew valley mod forum under the username "thatotterthing". Please let me know if you see them floating around elsewhere.[/center]I do not own Morris or any stardew valley properties. I simply remade a sprite sheet of the fellow for modders to use as they will.
[center]+++++++++[/center]
[b]To use[/b]: This is just a Sprite sheet. You can use it in your mod or just in game if you want. ([i]please just credit though[/i]) If you do use it in your mod or in game please send me a screenshot! I would love to see/upload some pics since I haven't had time to use these for anything myself.  I'm totally cool with small edits as well. [i](Also if you do happen to use these let me know so I can post a link here for others to see! )[/i]

I tried my best to keep him as close to the stardew style as possible while still keeping him on the short and stout side and looking as much like Morris as possible.

There are now mod sheets compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5732946]Yoshimax's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12824]Marry Morris Mod![/url] These were done with permission and exist as an alternative to their sprites. I'm not affiliated with that mod and all that incredible work was done by Yoshimax! please support them and let them know how amazing their work is! 
I have not been able to test these with that mod yet so any feedback would be appreciated! please enjoy!
